title: Pistol Shrimp Ka Khaufnaak Sacch! 🦐 #shorts
idea: A tiny Pistol Shrimp snaps its claw so fast that it creates a bubble with speeds of 90 km/h and temperatures reaching over 4,700 °C.

lines.text: Ek chhota sa jhinga Sooraj jitna garam dhamaka kar sakta hai?
Yeh hai Pistol Shrimp, jo sirf 3 se 5 cm chhota hota hai.
Iska ek claw uski body se aadhe se bhi bada hota hai.
Jab yeh claw snap karta hai, to bubble 90 km/h ki speed se nikalta hai!
Bubble collapse hote hi temperature 4,700 °C tak pahunch jaata hai!
Yeh heat Sooraj ke surface ke taapmaan ke kareeb hai! Kya aapko pata tha?

facts.claim: Snapping shrimp grow to 3-5 cm in length.
The cavitation bubble reaches speeds of 90 km/h.
The collapsing bubble reaches temperatures over 4,700 °C.
